title: Dakka Time
subtitle: Shooting phase: pick a shooter, confirm targets, roll da dice

bullets: Click a unit (board or list) to make it da shooter — weapons wiv one target in sight aim demselves.
[b]Confirm (N weapons)[/b] locks da targets in and opens da dice dock.
[b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b] rolls everyfin'; [b]Roll to Hit ▶[/b] goes step by step. [b]Done[/b] closes each save card.
[b]Complete Shooting[/b] finishes da unit — den pick da next shooter or end da phase.
[b]Shoot All Remaining[/b] auto-fires every unit ya ain't bothered aimin' yerself.

prompt.text: Da Boyz are out of da wagon an' da Witchseekers are in slugga range. In da Shooting phase every unit gets one go at blastin' — let's teach yer trigger fingers.

prompt.kbm: Click yer [b]Boyz[/b] mob — on da board or in da unit list on da right. Wiv only one enemy in sight, deir weapons aim at da Witchseekers all by demselves.
prompt.pad: Glide {ls} onto da [b]Boyz[/b] mob an' press {a}. Deir weapons aim at da only target demselves.

hint.text: Da mob of ten south of da wagon. Da Warboss shoots wiv 'em — he's attached.

prompt.kbm: Da weapon list shows every gun an' who it's pointin' at — da button counts how many is locked. If a row still says [b](Click to Select)[/b], click da row, den click da Witchseekers. Den hit [b]Confirm[/b].
prompt.pad: If a gun row says [b](Click to Select)[/b], pick it wiv {a} an' aim at da Witchseekers. Den glide onto [b]Confirm[/b] an' press {a}.

hint.text: Ya don't have to fire every gun — Confirm locks whatever's assigned.

prompt.kbm: Da dice dock's open. [b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b] rolls every gun at once ([b]Roll to Hit ▶[/b] does it step by step). Enemy saves pop up a results card — click [b]Done[/b] on each. When da big button says [b]Complete Shooting[/b], click it to finish da mob's go.
prompt.pad: Press {a} on [b]Fast Roll All ⏩[/b], {a} on each [b]Done[/b] card, den {a} on [b]Complete Shooting[/b].

hint.text: Da 'Every step' dropdown picks how often da rollin' pauses. Stuck? Da big dock button always shows da next step.

prompt.kbm: Da wagon an' da grots could shoot too — ([b]Shoot All Remaining[/b] does 'em all in one go) — but we're savin' da ammo. Hit da big red button, check da phase summary, den [b]End Shooting Phase[/b].
prompt.pad: Da wagon an' grots could shoot too — we're savin' ammo. Press {menu}, den confirm [b]End Shooting Phase[/b] on da summary.

hint.text: Da summary counts yer hits an' casualties — Go Back if ya forgot someone.
